name: Track B faithful retry plan after GPU efficiency guards
purpose: Record the concrete Track B retry plan after P0 profiling and batched Sudoku equivalence guards. This item chooses a parameter-count-valid TRM-class shape, one-GPU-per-seed topology, required trainer changes, and reporting gates for a future optimized retry. It is not a training result and makes no speedup or learned-gate claim.

code_added_used.change: Added the launch plan, preconditions, model shape, GPU topology, gated candidate commands, and reporting criteria for the next Track B retry.

commands.purpose: Compute real parameter counts from the existing PerCellTokenRecurrentOperator implementation before selecting a retry shape.

preconditions: item041 P0 baseline remains the before-optimization comparison
item042 batched ops equivalence remains green
trainer supports GPU-resident dataset sampling, bf16 autocast, torch.compile, and parameter-count assertion before launch

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not run training, does not claim speedup, and does not establish learned Track B acceptance. It only records the next faithful retry plan and the code gates that must be implemented before launch.
limitations: The current trainer still needs GPU-resident sampling, bf16, compile, and parameter assertion flags before the planned commands are valid.
The chosen feedforward dimension is intentionally large to satisfy the 5-8M parameter-count gate with hidden_dim 384; throughput must be measured against item041 before any launch claim.
DataParallel is explicitly excluded for the retry because item041/item040 evidence showed pipeline overhead and profiler aggregation issues for this small tied model.
